Name: K9 Del Rio
Short description: All season mud terrain tire for ATV & UTV vehicles with enhanced traction, stability, and durability.
Description: The K9 Del Rio is a mud terrain, all season tire manufactured for ATVs and UTVs. The ideal tread design manages to keep constant surface contact on versatile terrain surfaces. The non-directional tread design greatly upgrades steering responsiveness and driving stability. The large staggered blocks optimize its soft, loose, and uneven terrain traction. The special tread design eliminates mud and snow from the tread, which keeps the footprint clean and improves constant surface contact. The K9 Del Rio promotes excellent traction on versatile terrain and offers a secure performance throughout the year.
